plugins.summary: Spread one ripple on the water, seen at a low angle across it (mizuwa). The same broken rings and bleeding drop as the ripple seen from above are widened a little and flattened to about a third of their height, each outer ring's center a little lower so the rings open toward the viewer. The lines are thin brush, the inner three ultramarine and the outer three pale ink (gray). Five short pale-ink horizontal strokes, like light reflected on the water, lie to the sides of and below the rings. The whole tilts slightly, up to 3 degrees either way. The written ring count (1–6), or 4–5 when none is written. It sits at one of five positions in the lower half of the canvas.
